methodology.notes: EH1.0 v4.1Flash (Entroprism Harness) is a custom half-duplex agent. Agent brain: openai/deepseek-v4.1-flash (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash) served through the Volcengine Ark plan endpoint. User simulator: openai/deepseek-v4-flash via the same endpoint. Agent temperature 0, seed 42, tau2 base split, 4 trials per task, all 97 banking_knowledge tasks covered (single-domain submission). The agent uses the standard tau2 tool interface with a custom system prompt and step-wise verification discipline; no tasks omitted. Knowledge access uses the 'doubao' retrieval config.

verification.details: Custom EH1.0 v4.1Flash agent system prompt; standard tau2 tools and user simulator model with unmodified task set.
